info.description: Gets the requested publisher profile(s) by publisher accountId.
info.title: Ad Exchange Buyer API

requests.description: Retrieves the authenticated user's list of accounts.
requests.name: GET /accounts
requests.note: Replace {{AD_EXCHANGE_BUYER_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: Gets one account by ID.
requests.name: GET /accounts/{id}
requests.note: Replace {{AD_EXCHANGE_BUYER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Updates an existing account. This method supports patch semantics.
requests.name: PATCH /accounts/{id}
requests.note: Replace {{AD_EXCHANGE_BUYER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Updates an existing account.
requests.name: PUT /accounts/{id}
requests.note: Replace {{AD_EXCHANGE_BUYER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Retrieves a list of billing information for all accounts of the authenticated user.
requests.name: GET /billinginfo
requests.note: Replace {{AD_EXCHANGE_BUYER_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: Returns the billing information for one account specified by account ID.
requests.name: GET /billinginfo/{accountId}
requests.note: Replace {{AD_EXCHANGE_BUYER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Returns the budget information for the adgroup specified by the accountId and billingId.
requests.name: GET /billinginfo/{accountId}/{billingId}
requests.note: Replace {{AD_EXCHANGE_BUYER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Updates the budget amount for the budget of the adgroup specified by the accountId and billingId, with the budget amount in the request. This method supports patch semantics.
requests.name: PATCH /billinginfo/{accountId}/{billingId}
requests.note: Replace {{AD_EXCHANGE_BUYER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Updates the budget amount for the budget of the adgroup specified by the accountId and billingId, with the budget amount in the request.
requests.name: PUT /billinginfo/{accountId}/{billingId}
requests.note: Replace {{AD_EXCHANGE_BUYER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Retrieves a list of the authenticated user's active creatives. A creative will be available 30-40 minutes after submission.
requests.name: GET /creatives
requests.note: Replace {{AD_EXCHANGE_BUYER_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: Submit a new creative.
requests.name: POST /creatives
requests.note: Replace {{AD_EXCHANGE_BUYER_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: Gets the status for a single creative. A creative will be available 30-40 minutes after submission.
requests.name: GET /creatives/{accountId}/{buyerCreativeId}
requests.note: Replace {{AD_EXCHANGE_BUYER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Add a deal id association for the creative.
requests.name: POST /creatives/{accountId}/{buyerCreativeId}/addDeal/{dealId}
requests.note: Replace {{AD_EXCHANGE_BUYER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Lists the external deal ids associated with the creative.
requests.name: GET /creatives/{accountId}/{buyerCreativeId}/listDeals
requests.note: Replace {{AD_EXCHANGE_BUYER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Remove a deal id associated with the creative.
requests.name: POST /creatives/{accountId}/{buyerCreativeId}/removeDeal/{dealId}
requests.note: Replace {{AD_EXCHANGE_BUYER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Retrieves the authenticated user's list of performance metrics.
